blocks.text: Washington, United States—From starving cattle in parched El Salvador to a “terrifying” threat to the world’s coral reefs, this year’s exceptionally strong El Nino is being felt across the globe. Here is how it is playing out across AFP’s network. READ: Record El Nino? Depends who’s counting Threats to coral reefs and forests This year’s El Nino adds “a terrifying level of additional risk” for the world’s coral reefs, David Obura, chair of the UN’s expert nature panel, told AFP. Corals are highly sensitive to heat, and climate change is making bleaching events more frequent and intense. Obura led a major reassessment […]...
